newsitem.title: UK: Redland bounces as Kleinwort repeats "buy".
newsitem.headline: Redland bounces as Kleinwort repeats "buy".

text.p: Shares in British building materials group Redland Plc, which have lost more than 20 percent of their value since mid-September, bounced back on Monday as brokerage Kleinwort Benson repeated its "buy" recommendation, dealers said.
By 1030 GMT, the shares were up 7p to 377p, while the FTSE 100 slipped 6.3 points to 4,051.7.
Analysts at Kleinwort Benson could not immediately be reached for comment.

Shares in the UK building materials group had been under heavy selling pressure after its interim results fell short of market expectations and amid concerns that the strength in sterling would squeeze profits during the second half.
